reason: Build-time lint; no endpoint, schema, status code or message added or changed (story file v1 §10, TC-TE-011-11). API Specification v4 is read as an input file only.

buildToolContract.trigger: Every merge request pipeline and every branch pipeline, including main (story file v1 §12; SPEC-TE011-013)
inputs: Dictionary as seeded and changed by migrations: sys_fields.is_personal from the baseline infra/postgres/schema/03-recovery-physical-schema-v6.sql, then backend/src/main/resources/db/modulemigration/recovery/*.sql in Flyway order (a migration row replaces a baseline row), then any configured dictionary file. Recognised forms: INSERT ... VALUES single-row or multi-row; UPDATE ... SET is_personal WHERE field_id = / IN (literal ids). Any other statement writing sys_fields fails closed (SPEC-TE011-001). Marks made by a D-RCV-29 dictionary load are not read: the lint covers committed SQL, fixtures and logs only (seam owned by RWB-E1-064, decision in RWB-E1-043 open item R4 owned by RW-COMPLY; SPEC-TE011-017)
Scan roots must cover, and exclusions must not match, any file or probe path in backend/src/main/resources/db/modulemigration/recovery/; otherwise exit 2 (SPEC-TE011-003)
Changed-file list (--changed-files <file>) in a merge request pipeline; empty in a branch pipeline (SPEC-TE011-013, -018)
buildToolContract.generated: pdpa-rules.yaml in build output, CI artifact, not committed (SPEC-TE011-002)
buildToolContract.outputLine: {rule}: {file}:{line} uses personal field {field}. Remove it or use the masking helper.

exitCodes.2: configuration or input error, including an unsupported sys_fields statement, a duplicate seed row across migrations, an UPDATE of an unknown field_id, an allow entry whose path matches a migration, a scan configuration that excludes or omits the migration folder, or a corrective migration that names an unknown file

buildToolContract.neverPrinted: Any value found, any source line or SQL statement text, any fixture value (BR7)
buildToolContract.state: None; rerun to restart; same commit and dictionary give the same output
buildToolContract.fixtureMatching: FIXTURE-FIELD matches by (object, field) keys: object_name.field_name, source_field table.column, API schema.property. A position is resolved only when the dictionary describes that field on that object; otherwise (no object, an object outside the dictionary, or an undescribed field) an unambiguous name is a finding, an API personal name in an API-typed position is a finding, and an ambiguous name gives a notice. Scanned SQL with no named column (column-less INSERT with a literal, COPY ... FROM, \copy ... from) is a finding with field (columns not named) (SPEC-TE011-008). Every scanned SQL statement is classified: position forms (named-column INSERT with ON CONFLICT, RETURNING, WHERE or a read-only WITH; UPDATE ... SET), non-position forms (DDL, COMMENT ON, grants, settings, transaction control, reads, DELETE, TRUNCATE, maintenance), procedural bodies, and anything else. Anything else is a finding with field (statement not recognised); DML in a DO block is a finding with field (DML in procedural body) (SPEC-TE011-008)
noticeLines: PDPA-NOTICE: {file}:{line} object not resolved for {field}; add a fixtureObjects entry or a typed receiver
PDPA-NOTICE: {file}:{line} seeds {field}, marked personal by a later migration
buildToolContract.correctiveMigration: A finding in a merged migration O is accepted only when a later migration C (Flyway order) has O's line-1 story key, a line 2 starting '-- Fix:' with a non-empty reason that names O (token V\d{4}__[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.sql), an UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE on the finding's target table, and O is not on the changed-file list (SPEC-TE011-018)
buildToolContract.excludedMigrationFolderLine: scan configuration excludes the migration folder: {config key}
